Job Description:
 DevOps Engineer 
 Airbus Defence and Space is one of the three Divisions of the Airbus Group and Europe’s Number 1 defence and space company. It is the world’s second largest space company and one of the top 10 defence companies globally. Airbus Defence and Space develops and engineers cutting-edge and peerlessly reliable products in the field of defence and space. Its defence and space technologies enable governments and institutions to protect natural resources, societies and individual freedom.
As a member of our growing DevOps Engineering team, you responsibility is the day to day development and continuous enhancement, in order to meet the demands of our business. To be successful, you must have an automation-first mindset and deep expert knowledge in one of the core technical domains of our platform (Cloud Services, DevOps/Automation, Software-defined storage/backup, Software-defined networks, IAM, CMDB) as well as sound knowledge in one of the other areas listed below. In your role, you are part of a scrum development team and build services jointly with members of other disciplines.
www.airbusdefenceandspace.com
Interest group:
DevOps
Contract type/working time:
Unlimited
Work experience:
min 5 years
We are looking for DevOps Engineer to become part of the Airbus Defence and Space Romania team. Areas of impact: DevOps 
 Responsibilities: 
Define competitive end-to-end solutions together with top experts from different teams in an international environment.
Develop automated software delivery process as part of the DevOps Cloud Solutions Team
As part of our dynamic and agile team, ensure robustness, performance and security aspects within the architecture design 
Ensure that our solutions fit smoothly into our customers’ IT environments
As part of our dynamic and agile team, ensure robustness, performance and security aspects within the architecture design.
On top, identify dependencies and drive technical requirements clarification with stakeholders across customers, Airbus and Tier1s to ensure a coherent end-to-end solution. 
 R equirements: 
Proven experience (at least 3-5 years) in enterprise network technologies as well as experience working in complex IT environments.
Sound understanding of virtualization techniques and hypervisor environments.
Experience in scripting and DevOps tools and techniques such as GitLab CI, Ansible and Terraform.
Knowledge in Kubernetes architectures is considered as a strong advantage.
Strong system-level troubleshooting skills and the ability to identify and resolve high-level scalability and performance issues.
Awareness of security threats and corresponding security know-how.
Excellent communication skills to address needs and propose solutions towards customers and internal stakeholders.
 Proficiency with at least four of the following areas:
 Ansible
 DevOps Tools (Jenkins, GitLab, Artifactory, Ansible Tower, ...)
 Infrastructure as Code / Configuration as Code
 Kubernetes / OCP / Rancher / Docker
 Databases (MySQL, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, ...)
 Programming Languages (Python, Ruby, ...)
 Privileged Access Management solutions
 Expert knowledge in one of the following areas and solid knowledge in a second one:
 DevOps/Automation
 Infrastructure (Compute, Network, Storage/Backup)
 IAM
 CMDB
 Competencies: 
Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills with a strong sense of customer service. 
Solution oriented with a high sense of quality, attention to detail, accuracy, efficiency, and meeting tight deadlines. 
Team player who is also able to work independently and handle conflicting priorities while maintaining consistent, quality performance standards. 
Working in a multicultural environment / as part of a team 
 What do we offer you? 
 A great place to develop your career
 Exciting and meaningful projects
 Continuous education and training
 A motivating salary and a comprehensive package of benefits
 Performance related bonus
 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
